question: Where is the nearest restaurant you’d find going toward the Beverly Collective, Broomfield, CO starting at Action Behavior Centers - ABA therapy for Autism, Longmont, CO?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Action Behavior Centers%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Longmont%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Beverly Collective%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Broomfield%' LIMIT 1 ), bearings AS ( SELECT (SELECT geometry FROM start_point) AS start_geom, (SELECT geometry FROM destination_point) AS dest_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth((SELECT geometry FROM start_point), (SELECT geometry FROM destination_point))) AS bearing_to_destination ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state, ST_Distance(b.start_geom, p.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters FROM pois p, bearings b WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND b.start_geom IS NOT NULL AND b.dest_geom IS NOT NULL -- Filter restaurants that are within a reasonable distance from the start point AND ST_DWithin(b.start_geom, p.geometry::geography, 50000) -- Search within 50 km radius -- Filter restaurants that are in the general direction of the destination (within +/- 45 degrees) AND ( ABS(MOD(degrees(ST_Azimuth(b.start_geom, p.geometry)) - b.bearing_to_destination + 180 + 360, 360) - 180) < 45 ) ORDER BY ST_Distance(b.start_geom, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
